founderRules.Founder scoring trigger: If a governed target face contains numerical SCORING values, score those values. Do not reduce the result to Total Taps.
founderRules.Publisher override: If publisher/governing authority assigns a numeral a different meaning (example: Air Strike number = hits required to destroy), preserve that published meaning instead of treating the numeral as points.
founderRules.Scored tap: A tap classified inside one governed numeric scoring region contributes that region's printed numeric value.
founderRules.Miss / outside: Any tap outside all governed scoring regions is MISS / 0 points.
founderRules.Distribution integrity: Every tap must reconcile exactly once: scored region OR miss/outside. No dropped taps and no double counting.
founderRules.Boundary: Use existing governed target/family boundary semantics where stored. Do not invent a line-touch policy from artwork.
founderRules.Backend authority: Geometry and region-value bindings live in Backend Authority. Pixels/images are evidence/representation only.
founderRules.SCORING result: Show SCORE, HIT RATE, POINTS PER TAP, scored-hit distribution, misses, and TOTAL TAPS.
founderRules.GAME result: Show publisher-governed objective/progress/outcome plus tap reconciliation. Do not replace the game with Total Taps.
founderRules.OBJECT / ZONE result: Show hits by governed object/zone, useful objects hit/remaining where applicable, misses, and total taps.
founderRules.EVIDENCE ONLY result: Total Taps is acceptable only when no stronger governed scoring/game/object semantics are established.
founderRules.Cody responsibility: Wire the schema exactly. Do not research new rules, reinterpret artwork, or invent values.
founderRules.Founder responsibility: Founder approves the shooter-facing result/usefulness after Cody wiring and N/N proof.
